title: finding(plugin-detail): `record:activity`'s landmark is spoken 「Discussion」 while its visible heading reads 「Activity (N)」 — and `record:chatter`, which passes `titleLabel`, does not have the defect

<sub>⬆️ Written by the `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) at its ACCEPT `5813498551`: the work is delivered in PR objectui#10237, and landing waits on the Spec Main Shape Gate drift. ⛔ Nothing else in this body was touched. · 2026-09-24T11:49Z</sub>

Path: P2 | 可达性(语音输入用户) | 违反本仓自有 pin

`RecordActivityTimeline`'s landmark is named **「Discussion」** while the visible `h2` inside it reads **「Activity (N)」**. A speech-input user who says what they see cannot reach it — and the repo's **own** pin states that principle verbatim.

## The two lines, seat-verified at source on objectui `origin/main`

```
packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx
 :309  <section …                                       ← the root element
 :320    aria-label={t('detail.discussion')}            ← the LANDMARK's spoken name
 :322    <header className="mb-4">
 :324      <h2 …>
 :326        {titleLabel ?? t('detail.activity')}       ← the VISIBLE name
 :328        ({filtered.length})
```

⇒ mounted by `record:activity`, which passes no `titleLabel`, the landmark announces 「Discussion」 and the screen reads 「Activity (3)」.

## ⭐ The control that makes this a defect rather than a preference

**`record:chatter` does NOT have it.** `RecordChatterPanel` passes `titleLabel={t('detail.discussion')}` — at `:168` on the sidebar path and `:225` on the inline path — so the heading and the landmark **agree** there.

⇒ the **same component** is named consistently on one mount and inconsistently on the other, and the difference is one prop. ⭐ That asymmetry is the failing probe: it rules out 「this is just how the component is」.

## The contract it violates — class (a), and the contract is this repo's own

`packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ReportConfigPanel.panelTitle.test.tsx:117`, verbatim:

> A speech-input user says what they see, so the landmark's spoken name must be the heading, not a paraphrase of it.

That pin is objectui#4118's, and 「Discussion」 is ⛔ not even a paraphrase of 「Activity」 — it is a different word.

⚠️ And APG's preferred shape for naming a region is `aria-labelledby` pointing at a **visible header**. There is a visible header right there at `:324`, unreferenced.

## ⚠️ A sibling pin's premise sentence is now FALSE, and whoever fixes this must not leave it standing

`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/detail-landmark-aria-i18n-4645.test.tsx:18` reads:

> …`lateral`). **Both sections carry no visible label of their own**, so the `aria-label` IS the landmark as far as assistive tech is concerned.

That was true when objectui#4645 minted the ten-pack localized landmark names. It is ⛔ **false today** for `RecordActivityTimeline`, which has the `h2` at `:324`. ⇒ the sentence should be dated and corrected in the same change, ⛔ not left to mislead the next reader into thinking `aria-labelledby` is unavailable here.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

⛔ Not that the nesting is wrong: that was objectui#9946's question and it was measured **permitted and acceptable** (axe-core 4.13.0 across wcag2a/2aa/21a/21aa/22aa/best-practice, zero landmark violations on all five container blocks). This defect reproduces in **both** legs — with and without an authored `aria` bag — so it is ⛔ independent of that question.
⛔ Not measured: what NVDA / JAWS / VoiceOver actually **announce**. No AT exists in the container that produced these readings; the accessibility **tree** was measured, the announcement was not.
⛔ No instance claimed in an authored document.

## ⭐ A note for whoever takes it: the instrument is already installed

`axe-core@4.13.0` and `vitest-axe@0.1.0` are root devDependencies with **zero consumers** anywhere in the tree (`vitest-axe` / `toHaveNoViolations` / `axe(` return nothing across `packages`, `apps`, `examples`). objectui#9946's measurement proves they work today. ⇒ reach for them rather than hand-rolling a landmark walker. ⛔ Not filed as its own card — declared-but-inert dev tooling is not one of the three classes — but it is the cheapest thing a taker can know.
